rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE-accredited providers, or non-ACPE courses pre-approved by the Board (government/regulatory agency programs, pharmacy-related programs, suicide assessment/referral/treatment training); post-graduate credits at an accredited pharmacy, medical or dental school
rules.audit_note: Random CE audits; keep proof for two renewal cycles. False attestation: discipline and up to a $1,000 late CE fee.
rules.notes: 30 hours (3.0 CE units) earned Nov 1 to Oct 31 of even years, before renewing. No mandatory subjects except: vaccinators 2 h on vaccines/CDC guidelines, MTS certificate holders 6 h medication therapy management, clotting factor dispensers 4 h; all count toward the 30.

topics.who: Vaccinating pharmacists: vaccines/CDC guidelines, counts toward the 30
